risk_note: RV2 (union archive; order ownership evidence). FU-TB-ARCHIVE-EDGE ① (B1-04zzc read-only re-check S2): the Taobao order-details, punishment and refund archive rewrites (taobaoOrderArchiveBody, taobaoPunishArchiveBody, taobaoRefundArchiveBody) used to return the page as received when the parsed tree had nothing to drop; with a duplicate JSON key (e.g. two publisher_order_dto / results / result members) JSON.parse keeps the last copy, so foreign rows in an earlier copy were archived. A shared detector (taobaoJsonHasDuplicateKeys in taobao/orders.ts: every object level incl. objects in arrays, keys compared decoded, string escapes skipped) and taobaoArchiveAsParsed now re-serialize such a body by parse semantics (last wins, number literals kept) and the usual per-kind filter still runs, so foreign rows in the winning copy are dropped too (spec-test S2, pinned by [AC-B1-04zgb-UNIT#1..3]). Bodies without duplicate keys are byte-for-byte unchanged. No change to the archive wrapper, error codes, logs, returned items or amounts. Single-object publisher_order_dto (②) and non-2xx empty payload (③) are out of scope (await the orchestrator).

reviews.note: Codex usage limit until 11-15 (D10-823 ④): money review by a fresh independent Claude via tools/agent/claude-run.sh, round 1 pass with no findings.

spec_test_review.note: Rule tests (test/spec/union/taobao-archive-duplicate-keys/, 3 files, 11 tests) by a fresh independent Claude; red at the base. spec-test review by a fresh independent Claude round 1 pass with three S2 of one kind (no test had a foreign row in the winning copy, so a re-serialize-and-return shortcut would pass) — handled in the implementation and pinned by unit tests [AC-B1-04zgb-UNIT#1..3].
